title: speicher.md page frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter in a content file. Stripped before rendering, never emitted as content. Parsed with YAML 1.2 core schema. Frontmatter NEVER affects access — an `access` key is rejected, not warned.

title.description: The page title. Defaults to the page's first `# Heading`, then to the file name.

description.description: A short summary of the page, used in search results and as its meta description.

icon.description: Name of a Lucide icon (https://lucide.dev/icons), such as `book-open`, shown next to the page in the navigation and folder listings. An unknown name is ignored with a warning.

redirect_from.description: Old addresses that redirect to this page, as full paths including the repository, such as `/handbook/old-page`. An address of an existing page or of another repository is ignored with a warning.

draft.description: `true` leaves the file out of the site completely.

indexable.description: `false` keeps the page out of AI retrieval. It cannot turn retrieval back on where a `.speicher.yaml` turned it off.

tags.description: Topics that relate this page to others with the same tag. Matching ignores upper and lower case. Tags never affect who can read the page.

sidebar_position.description: Docusaurus's ordering key. Used only in folders where no file has a number prefix.

sidebar.description: Starlight's sidebar block. Only `order` is read; the rest is ignored.

$comment: Access keys are rejected rather than ignored. Per-file grants were cut in favour of directory granularity; permitting them here would reintroduce them and add a fourth cascade level with different semantics.
